claims.text: The Morfessor EM+Prune algorithm finds better solutions to the optimization problem than the original recursive training algorithm, leading to higher morphological segmentation accuracy.
The evaluation of the training algorithm's performance includes comparing the segmentation output to linguistic gold standards using metrics like boundary precision and F1-score.
Morfessor EM+Prune reduces search error during training, resulting in models with lower Morfessor costs and improved accuracy in segmentation.
